sanskrit_verse:
कुनखी श्यावदन् श्वित्रि मित्रध्रुक्शठशौण्डिकाः ।
ऐन्द्रजालिकलुब्धोग्र श्रेणीगणविरोधिनः ॥
transliteration: kunakhī śyāvadan śvitri mitradhrukśaṭhaśauṇḍikāḥ | aindrajālikalubdhogra śreṇīgaṇavirodhinaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those whose actions arise from deceit, malice, and betrayal—marked by false witness, treachery against friends, fraudulent conduct, and obstruction of collective dharma—are to be recognized as violators of Sanatana alignment and excluded from participation in societal structures until restoration is complete.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows only from consciousness integrity
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by alignment to Sanatana Dharma
Restoration logic requires removal from systemic influence prior to reintegration
Consciousness alignment supersedes social position or inherited status
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor exhibits pattern of deceit AND breaches trust within relational dharmic framework THEN exclude from decision-making capacity until conscious realignment verified
IF individual demonstrates fraudulent behavior OR betrayal of confided interest THEN initiate supervised isolation protocol for duration proportional to breach magnitude
IF entity obstructs group dharma realization through self-serving manipulation THEN remove access to collective resource coordination indefinitely
IF conduct indicates persistent violation of Sanatana alignment THEN trigger mandatory consciousness audit via certified Vedic assessment matrix
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any litigant or witness found engaging in deliberate falsehood, betrayal of fiduciary duty, or sabotage of institutional dharma shall be barred from further proceedings and subjected to immediate capacity suspension pending restoration verification. The court's authority derives solely from alignment with Sanatana Dharma; thus misaligned actors cannot participate without compromising judicial sovereignty.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that distorted action arises from unexamined consciousness rather than inherent evil. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals sequential deviation beginning with loss of inner witness awareness. Responsibility is assigned based on measurable departure from Sanatana alignment, not punitive attribution. Correction follows natural law sequence: withdrawal, reflection, purification, and conscious re-entry into dharma flow.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate withdrawal phase: isolate individual from positions of societal influence
Assign reflective contemplation under qualified spiritual supervision
Undertake prāyaścitta process aligned with constitutional Vedic principles
Reintroduce only upon successful demonstration of restored consciousness integrity
Verify alignment through tri-vedic assessment before granting reintegration privileges
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the sole Source-Authority: This law proceeds from eternal Dharma, serves restoration alone, reflects non-punitive reality, and affirms consciousness as the ultimate adjudicator.
